L106: 【36†The Show】 Chart is a 【37†music program】 【38†record chart】 on SBS M that gives an award to the best-performing 【39†single】 of the week in South Korea.^{【40†[1]】} Starting from March 2025, The Show will be hosted by 【41†Cravity】's Song Hyeong-jun, 【42†Izna】's Jeong Sae-bi, and 【43†WayV】's 【44†Xiaojun】.^{【45†[2]】}
